product_one_liner.value: Paddle is a merchant-of-record payments and billing platform that handles checkout, subscriptions, global tax compliance, fraud protection and retention for SaaS, mobile-app, AI and other digital-product businesses.

employee_band.notes: Published employee range, not an exact headcount.

eng_blog.notes: Technical posts include George Wilson's article on Go microservices and Kieran Mountford's account of rebuilding Paddle's developer platform; both authors are heads of engineering.

public_docs.notes: Public developer portal includes quickstarts, SDK guidance and starter-kit documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Live Head of Data Science posting covering the UK, Ireland and Portugal.

model_provider.notes: No specific model powering Paddle's product was identified after reviewing product and AI documentation, Retain documentation, the AI Toolkit announcement, security FAQ, privacy policy and subprocessors. Compatibility with external AI development tools does not establish an underlying model provider.

compliance_certs.notes: The Trust Center lists SOC 2, GDPR and PCI DSS 4.0.1. GDPR is a compliance claim rather than a certification.

last_funding.notes: $25 million in growth financing from CIBC Innovation Banking, announced July 17, 2025; this was debt financing rather than an equity round.

raised_18mo.notes: The $25 million CIBC financing announced July 17, 2025 falls within the requested 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Live Senior Account Executive posting based in San Francisco.

launched_6mo.notes: Paddle announced its AI Toolkit on October 20, 2026, within the requested six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Diarmuid Considine's profile dates the start of his VP, Risk role at Paddle to September 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Paddle's marketing-operations posting names HubSpot and Dreamdata in its stack. Salesforce usage is supported by a case study describing Paddle's 2021 Juro implementation integrated with Salesforce.
